name: SDGOODS AI Toolkit
display_zh: 谷仓次元屏 · AI 辅助开发工具包
display_en: SDGOODS Electric Badge · AI Dev Toolkit
device: SDGOODS-ESP32S3 (ESP32-S3-R8 + 圆形 ST77916 360x360 + LVGL 8.3.11 + IDF 5.5.0)
description_zh: 让 AI（WorkBuddy / Claude Code / Cursor / Codex 等）克隆本仓库后，立刻能按规范在谷仓次元屏上二次开发、加应用、编译烧录，并一键提交到谷仓 SDGOODS 开放平台。
description_en: Lets any AI coding assistant (WorkBuddy / Claude Code / Cursor / Codex) clone this repo and immediately develop, build, flash, and publish firmware for the SDGOODS Electric Badge per project conventions.

skills.summary_zh: 跑 check_env.py，解析 MUST/WARN，逐项报出缺失项与安装指引。二次开发改代码前的第一道基础。
skills.summary_en: Run check_env.py, parse MUST/WARN, list missing deps and install hints. The first gate before touching firmware.
skills.trigger_zh: 检查 / 准备 SDGOODS 开发环境
skills.trigger_en: verify / prepare the SDGOODS badge dev environment

skills.summary_zh: new_app.py 一键生成 main/apps/<app>.c 并自动注册到启动台与每帧轮询，封装两层架构接线点、保留插入标记。
skills.summary_en: new_app.py scaffolds main/apps/<app>.c and auto-registers it to the launcher and per-frame poll, keeping the two-layer wiring markers intact.
skills.trigger_zh: add / 新建 / scaffold 一个新应用
skills.trigger_en: add / scaffold a new app for the badge

skills.title_zh: 编译 · 烧录 · 验证
skills.summary_zh: idf.py build + flash，封装 env 坑（unset 三变量、不 rm -rf build）、原地构建、端口烧录、串口日志 + 截屏验证。
skills.summary_en: idf.py build + flash with the env gotchas (unset 3 sandbox vars, never rm -rf build), in-place build, port flash, serial log + screenshot verify.
skills.trigger_zh: build / 编译 / flash / 烧录 / verify 固件
skills.trigger_en: build / flash / verify the badge firmware

skills.summary_zh: 把谷仓次元屏经 USB 串口发的原始位图还原成 PNG，给 AI「看图」验证 UI/字体/画面。单张约 2~25s。
skills.summary_en: Restore the badge's raw serial bitmap into a PNG so the AI can 'see' the UI/fonts/screen. ~2-25s per shot.
skills.trigger_zh: screenshot / 截屏 / 验证 UI
skills.trigger_en: screenshot / capture the badge screen / verify UI visually

skills.summary_zh: 改中文后重跑 gen_fonts.py（扫描字符集、生成两套 OFL 字体）+ font_metrics.py（离线核对圆屏宽度与缺字），漏字=方框。
skills.summary_en: After changing Chinese text, rerun gen_fonts.py (scan charset, build two OFL fonts) + font_metrics.py (offline circle-screen width & missing-glyph check). Missing glyph = tofu box.
skills.trigger_zh: 字体 / 方框 / 缺字 / 超宽 / tofu
skills.trigger_en: Chinese text / fonts / tofu / missing glyph

skills.summary_zh: 把做好的固件提交到谷仓 SDGOODS 开放平台。优先走本地 MCP server，否则回退 sdgoods_publish.py（邮箱验证码登录）。
skills.summary_en: Submit built firmware to the SDGOODS open platform. Prefers the local MCP server; falls back to sdgoods_publish.py (email-code login).
skills.trigger_zh: publish / 提交 / upload 固件到开放平台
skills.trigger_en: publish / upload firmware to the SDGOODS open platform

agent.summary_zh: 把项目硬约束（两层边界、许可、联机铁律）与 6 个 Skill 固化成一个可复用角色。WorkBuddy 可作 Expert 包；Claude/Cursor 作 subagent 加载。
agent.summary_en: Bakes project hard rules (two-layer boundary, license, networking invariants) and the 6 Skills into a reusable role. Load as Expert pack in WorkBuddy, or subagent in Claude/Cursor.

mcp_server.title_zh: 开放平台 MCP server（本地客户端）
mcp_server.summary_zh: 纯标准库、stdio 的 MCP server，把固件一键上传到谷仓 SDGOODS 开放平台。只调公开 REST API，不含密钥、不含服务端代码。
mcp_server.summary_en: Pure-stdlib, stdio MCP server that uploads firmware to the SDGOODS open platform. Calls only public REST APIs; no keys, no server code.

tools.summary_zh: 邮箱验证码登录（两步）；凭据缓存本机 ~/.sdgoods/credentials.json (600)。
tools.summary_en: Email-code login (two steps); creds cached locally at ~/.sdgoods/credentials.json (600).

tools.summary_zh: 列出平台合法分类 slug（提交前核对）。
tools.summary_en: List valid category slugs (verify before publish).

tools.sig: upload_firmware(file, name, category, desc_zh?, desc_en?, version?, hardware?, tags?, shots?, github?, draft?)
tools.summary_zh: presign 直传 + 创建固件记录，返回固件 id。
tools.summary_en: Presign upload + create firmware record, returns firmware id.

platforms.mcp_location: 合并进 ~/.workbuddy/mcp.json（或在设置→MCP 连接器粘贴）
claude mcp add sdgoods -- python3 <server> 或 .mcp.json

security.note_zh: 本仓库不含任何密钥 / token；MCP 登录走邮箱验证码，凭据只存本机 ~/.sdgoods/credentials.json (600) 或 MCP 会话内。开放平台后端不开源，本清单只描述客户端配置与协议。
security.note_en: This repo ships no keys/tokens. MCP login uses email-code; creds live only in local ~/.sdgoods/credentials.json (600) or the MCP session. The open-platform backend is closed source; this catalog only describes client config and protocol.
